title: Horizontal racing game based on Worm's ninja rope
author: salmonado
selftext:
Hi there! I've been working on this for the past few days with Fable 5.1

I always loved the ninja rope mechanic in Worms so I made a game that focuses on it. 

It pretty much one-shotted the whole thing in about 2h, graphics, music, mechanics, UI.  
Levels are procedurally generated from a list of blocks.

I spent a few more days polishing and improving the gameplay. It's hard to use on mobile right now, intended to be played with a mouse and keyboard. I need to tweak a lot of things but it's already pretty fun! Let me know what you think!

[https://racoon-swing.fly.dev/](https://racoon-swing.fly.dev/)

comments.author: Dont_Bring_Me_Down
comments.body:
This looks fun!! 

I’m building Swipe Arcade, a gameplay-first discovery platform for browser games, and this feels like exactly the kind of game I’d love to have people stumble into and try.

If you get the mobile controls where you want them, I’d love for you to submit it for the rotation: swipe-arcade.com/submit

Keep building this!
